question: Is the component U2 connected to Microcontroller_LED?

response.reasoning: Looking at the netlist, U2 (MAX31855KASA) is connected to nets: GND (pin 1), Net-(J1-Pin_1) (pin 2/T-), Net-(J1-Pin_2) (pin 3/T+), +3V3 (pin 4/VCC), SCK (pin 5), CS0 (pin 6/~CS~), SO (pin 7). The /Microcontroller/LED net connects D1 pin 4 (DIN) and U1 pin 12 (GPIO0). U2 has no connection to the /Microcontroller/LED net.
